notes: PB5770: a READ that sets a lock takes its grant before the retrieval, as a test-and-set the host arbitrates, so the lock test and the lock are one atomic operation: a grant another run unit took first is the record operation conflict ('51', no record made available, the file position indicator unchanged, the RETRY phrase honored), never dropped, and a READ that answers success holds the lock it was required to set. Cited: §2002:12.3.4.8.3 GR8.
